# DeepSeek: FlashMLA & DeepGEMM
DeepSeek stunned the AI industry by open-sourcing compact, ultra-efficient kernels that outcompeted monolithic enterprise libraries.

### FlashMLA: Multi-Head Latent Attention

DeepSeek-V3 and R1 utilize Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) to compress KV caches into low-dimensional latent spaces. 
Standard attention kernels cannot handle this asymmetrical projection efficiently. FlashMLA is custom-tuned to decode latent vectors directly into shared memory, cutting KV memory bandwidth consumption by over 70%.

### DeepGEMM: Clean Architecture over Brute Force

In fewer than 300 lines of readable, modular CUDA code, `DeepGEMM` implements fine-grained FP8 matrix multiplication with grouped scaling. 
By avoiding deeply nested template metaprogramming and focusing purely on optimal software pipelining and TMA scheduling, DeepGEMM matches and often beats commercial closed-source GEMM kernels.
